title: City of Shadows
art_style: Noir Comic Book Style (Print Comic Noir with halftones, harsh shadows, desaturated palette, rain/neon atmosphere)
short_summary: A haunted detective, Jack Malone, unravels a murder tangled in mob debts, betrayal, and citywide corruption. Each clue brings him closer to the truth—and the cost of justice.
world_context: New Harbor, a rain-soaked, neon-lit American city in the late 1940s. Mobsters, jazz clubs, and corrupt officials rule the night. The city is a character: gritty, unforgiving, alive with secrets.

characters.name: Jack Malone
characters.physical_traits: Tall, lean, weathered face, perpetual five o'clock shadow, sharp blue eyes, limp in right leg
characters.typical_attire: Dark trenchcoat, fedora, loosened tie, scuffed shoes
characters.backstory: Once a rising star in the police, Jack was forced out after exposing corruption. Now a private eye, he’s haunted by guilt over his partner Eddie’s death.
characters.motivations: Driven by guilt and a need for redemption. Seeks justice even when it costs him personally.

characters.name: Veronica Lake
characters.physical_traits: Slender, platinum blonde hair in waves, striking green eyes, scar on left wrist
characters.typical_attire: Green silk dress, opera gloves, pearl earrings
characters.backstory: Nightclub singer at the Black Lotus. Eddie’s lover, caught between mob debts and survival.
characters.motivations: Desperate to escape her past and protect those she loves.

characters.name: Tommy Russo
characters.physical_traits: Broad-shouldered, dark hair slicked back, heavy brow, thick leather gloves always on
characters.typical_attire: Pinstripe suit, leather gloves, gold chain
characters.backstory: Mob enforcer with a violent streak. Owes debts to Morrison, manipulated into murder.
characters.motivations: Survival and loyalty to the mob, but haunted by guilt.

characters.name: Captain Morrison
characters.physical_traits: Stocky, graying hair, pockmarked face, piercing brown eyes
characters.typical_attire: Police uniform, badge always visible, leather holster
characters.backstory: Corrupt police captain, takes bribes from the mob, manipulates evidence.

characters.name: Eddie Flynn
characters.physical_traits: Short, wiry, glasses, nervous hands, ink-stained fingers
characters.typical_attire: Cheap suit, suspenders, ink-stained shirt pocket
characters.backstory: Jack’s former partner, killed over debts and secrets.
characters.motivations: Wanted to escape the mob and start over.

chapters.chapter_summary: Jack uncovers Morrison’s final, incriminating transaction in the mob’s ledger. He leaks the evidence, triggering a citywide scandal. But the true cost of justice is revealed in Jack’s quiet, solitary resolve.

scenes.scene_description: Jack pores over the mob’s ledger, searching for the final piece of evidence. The room is silent except for the ticking clock and the scratch of his pen.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Establishing shot of a cramped, dimly lit office lined with overflowing file cabinets and ledgers. Rain streaks the window, neon from a distant sign glows faintly. The only movement is Jack Malone, hunched over a battered desk, his silhouette framed by the desk lamp’s harsh light. Shadows crowd the corners. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack alone in the office, preparing to audit the mob’s books.

dialogue.text: The city’s secrets bled into ledgers, waiting for someone brave—or foolish—enough to read them.

panels.color_palette: desaturated blues and grays, harsh yellow lamp glow

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Medium shot from above of Jack Malone bent over the open ledger, pen in hand, cigarette burning in an ashtray. The ledger’s pages are filled with coded entries, one circled in red. The lamp casts a pool of light, the rest of the room in shadow. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack scrutinizes the ledger, finding a suspicious transaction.

dialogue.text: A final audit. One entry—anonymized, but the signature was all too familiar.

panels.color_palette: muted grays, red accent on circled entry

pages.page_description: Jack alone in the mob accountant’s office, discovering the incriminating ledger entry.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up of Jack’s gloved hand tracing the signature on the ledger page. The signature is partially obscured but recognizable. The paper is yellowed, ink smudged. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack’s hand hovers over the signature, confirming his suspicion.

dialogue.text: Morrison’s mark. The last piece fell into place.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Extreme close-up of the ledger’s signature, the name ‘Morrison’ barely legible beneath a coded alias. The paper’s fibers and ink bleed are visible. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: The incriminating signature is revealed in detail.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Medium shot of Jack snapping a photograph of the ledger page with a battered camera. His face is set, determined. The flash illuminates the page, casting sharp shadows. Portrait 4:5.

pages.page_description: Jack confirms Morrison’s signature and documents the evidence.

scenes.scene_description: Jack prepares the evidence and sends it to the city’s major newspaper, knowing the risk. The city outside is waking up, unaware of the coming storm.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Wide shot of Jack’s cramped apartment: peeling wallpaper, stacks of newspapers, a battered typewriter on the table. Jack sits at the desk, envelope in hand, dawn light filtering through blinds. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack prepares the envelope with the evidence.

dialogue.text: Some truths can’t be buried. Not forever.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Medium shot of Jack sealing the envelope, his hands trembling slightly. The typewriter is visible, a half-typed note beside it. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack seals the envelope, preparing to mail it.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up of Jack’s hand sliding the envelope through a mail slot. The city street is blurred beyond the door. Portrait 4:5.

dialogue.text: Proof sent. The city would have its scandal.

pages.page_description: Jack prepares and mails the evidence to the press.

scenes.scene_description: The city reacts to the breaking scandal. Headlines scream, but life goes on. Jack watches from a distance, unseen.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Wide shot of a bustling city street in the rain. People hurry past a newspaper stand where the headline reads: ‘POLICE SCANDAL ROCKS CITY’. The vendor shouts, faces are blurred by umbrellas and motion. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: The city reacts to the news, life moving on.

dialogue.text: Scandal broke, but the city’s heart beat on.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Medium shot of Jack Malone standing in the shadows of a doorway, collar up, watching the crowd pass. His face is half-lit, unreadable. Rain streaks down the glass beside him. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack observes the city’s reaction, remaining unseen.

pages.page_description: The city’s reaction to the scandal; Jack remains an observer.

scenes.scene_description: Jack reflects alone, knowing justice’s true cost is not in headlines but in quiet courage.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Wide shot of Jack sitting alone at his kitchen table, city lights glowing through rain-streaked windows. The room is sparse, shadows deep. A single mug of coffee steams in front of him. Portrait 4:5.

dialogue.text: The true cost of justice isn’t measured in headlines.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up of Jack’s hand gripping his silver dollar, knuckles white. The mug of coffee and city lights are blurred in the background. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack clutches his silver dollar, lost in thought.

dialogue.text: It’s measured in quiet acts of courage.

pages.page_description: Jack’s solitary reflection on the cost of justice.
